prior_receipts.fact: hosted WIF probe in run 36509055237 found all five dev targets (oday-api, oday-web, migration/worker/scheduler jobs) absent in odayplus-runtime-20260825/asia-east1

rollout_precondition.required: an immutable rollout receipt: a Runtime Release run whose 'Deploy the admitted artifact by immutable digest' job concluded success for the environment
rollout_precondition.coverage: complete GitHub deployment history of dev, staging and production at capture time: every deployment (row count cross-checked against the GraphQL totalCount), every status of each deployment, and the full job list (all attempts) of every workflow run that put a deployment into success or inactive. Not covered: a deploy performed outside GitHub Actions (e.g. manual gcloud) leaves no GitHub deployment record and is invisible here; the hosted absence probe in prior_receipts is the only runtime-side check.

production.summary: zero GitHub deployments recorded for production

items.requirement: Dev/Staging/Production must not share the Production Secret; env vars, secrets, database, bucket and model alias separable
items.threshold: for every secret-bearing binding: no dev or staging Secret Manager secret version has the same value digest as any production secret version, and no dev/staging Cloud Run service or job runs as a production service account; zero secret values in any receipt
command_or_query: per environment, inside a WIF-authenticated job: gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=<ref> | sha256sum  (only the digest leaves the job)
items.time_window: single readback per environment taken after that environment's admitted deploy job succeeded, repeated at every release

observed_partial.plane: GitHub environment variables (deployment configuration, not runtime)
observed_partial.shared_with_production: none of the 10 compared keys (project, deployer SA, WIF provider, runtime SA, scheduler SA, four secret refs, snapshot bucket); all 10 keys are set in all three environments, and equality is derived from the per-environment fingerprints
observed_partial.disclosed: dev and staging share GCP_PROJECT_ID, GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT and GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER; SHARED-008 as written concerns only the Production Secret, so this is disclosed rather than counted as a violation

items.evidence_needed: secret value digests per environment and the service account plus secret refs bound on the deployed Cloud Run resources; references in GitHub variables cannot prove two secrets hold different values
items.evidence_owner: Human/Ops (GCP Secret Manager and Cloud Run read access in the production project; the auto worker's gcloud cannot reauthenticate non-interactively)
items.reopen_trigger: the first Runtime Release run for any environment whose deploy job concludes success

items.requirement: completed-result query API P95 <= 3 s; long tasks return job_id
items.threshold: p95 <= 3.0 s and 0 failures at 10/20/50 concurrency with 150 requests per run (ratified in docs/design/ODP-PGAP-RELIABILITY-001_SLO_AND_DR_TARGETS_RATIFICATION.md section 2); plus p95 <= 3.0 s on real traffic
command_or_query: load run against the deployed oday-api URL at 10, 20 and 50 concurrency, 150 requests each, raw per-request latencies kept
Cloud Monitoring: run.googleapis.com/request_latencies, service_name=oday-api, ALIGN_PERCENTILE_95 over the window
items.time_window: load runs on one deployed release; monitoring window >= 24 h after that release receives traffic
items.evidence_needed: a deployed oday-api revision identified by image digest, and latency samples taken from it
items.evidence_owner: Human/Ops (Cloud Monitoring read access); load run may be executed by the task owner once a deployed URL and an authenticated smoke identity exist
items.reopen_trigger: Runtime Release deploy job success for staging or production

items.requirement: daily ForecastOps, data quality and required ops batches finish before the operating day starts
items.threshold: every daily batch execution completes successfully before the operating-day start; the cut-off time is not defined in any repo document and must be supplied by Human/Ops before the check can pass
command_or_query: same for oday-scheduler-r-<release>; compare completionTime against the cut-off in Asia/Taipei
items.time_window: 7 consecutive operating days on one release
items.evidence_needed: scheduled worker/scheduler job executions in the target environment, and a stated operating-day cut-off
items.evidence_owner: Human/Ops (cut-off definition and Cloud Run job execution read access)
items.reopen_trigger: production deploy job success and a cut-off time recorded by Human/Ops

items.threshold: >= 99.5% successful checks over a calendar month
command_or_query: Cloud Monitoring uptime check on the production oday-web OpsBoard route; monitoring.googleapis.com/uptime_check/check_passed fraction over the month
items.time_window: one full calendar month on production
items.evidence_needed: a production deployment and an uptime check configured against it; dev or staging uptime does not satisfy this item
items.reopen_trigger: production deploy job success; the item can first be measured one calendar month later

items.requirement: important data has defined RPO/RTO approved by SA/OPS documents
items.threshold: RPO <= 60 min and RTO <= 240 min (ratified in docs/design/ODP-PGAP-RELIABILITY-001_SLO_AND_DR_TARGETS_RATIFICATION.md section 3); backup restores in staging and core queries verify (ODP-AC-NFR-007)
command_or_query: gcloud sql instances describe <instance> --format='value(settings.backupConfiguration)' (point-in-time recovery enabled, log retention)
restore drill: clone to a timestamp into staging, run core queries, record data-loss window and wall-clock recovery time
items.time_window: one timed restore drill on the deployed database; backup configuration read at the same time
items.evidence_needed: the deployed database instance and a restore drill against it; the existing dr_drill_records.json is a local shutil.copy drill and the ratification document states it does not demonstrate the targets
items.evidence_owner: Human/Ops (Cloud SQL admin access for the drill)
items.reopen_trigger: staging deploy job success with its database provisioned
